description: Source code for testing authentication and registration over UDS (Unix Domain Sockets) in a USP (User Services Platform) environment, including socket handling, message creation, and response parsing.

methods.name: VENDOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes vendor-specific operations and registers them with the USP framework.

methods.name: VENDOR_Start
methods.description: Performs startup tasks after data model registration.

methods.name: VENDOR_Stop
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks when stopping the USP agent.

methods.name: TestUdsAuth_Operate
methods.description: Starts the UDS authentication test operation, validating parameters and spawning a thread.

methods.name: TestUdsAuthThreadMain
methods.description: Main thread function for handling UDS authentication test, managing handshake and response.

methods.name: TestUdsRegister_Operate
methods.description: Starts the UDS registration test operation, validating parameters and spawning a thread.

methods.name: TestUdsRegThreadMain
methods.description: Main thread function for handling UDS registration, managing handshake, registration request, and response.

methods.name: DoUdsTestHandshake
methods.description: Performs UDS handshake by connecting, sending handshake frame, and validating response.

methods.name: CreateHandshakeFrame
methods.description: Constructs a UDS handshake frame with optional password.

methods.name: CreateRegisterFrame
methods.description: Constructs a UDS register request frame encapsulating a USP register message.

methods.name: ValidateHandshakeResponse
methods.description: Validates received handshake frame and extracts broker's EndpointID.

methods.name: UdsConnect
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking Unix domain socket connection with timeout handling.

methods.name: UdsSend
methods.description: Sends a UDS frame over the socket, handling partial sends and timeouts.

methods.name: UdsReceive
methods.description: Receives a complete UDS frame, including header and TLVs, with timeout handling.

methods.name: UdsReceiveFragment
methods.description: Receives a specified number of bytes from the socket, handling partial reads and timeouts.

methods.name: CloseTestSock
methods.description: Closes the socket used for UDS communication safely.

methods.name: DropRxedFrames
methods.description: Reads and discards all remaining UDS frames for the current connection.
